note.question: What determines the strategic implications of displaying deal sales and the website’s incentive to implement this feature?
note.overview: Daily deal websites help small local merchants to attract new consumers. A strategy adopted by some websites is to continually track and display the number of deals sold by a merchant. We investigate the strategic implications of displaying deal sales and the website’s incentive to implement this feature.
